the converted cockpit's ECAM control panel buttons only carry ecam-cp.xml's LEFT_SINGLE_CODE, never its LEFT_LEAVE_CODE, so each A32NX_BTN_* latched at 1 and FwsCore's rising-edge pulse nodes fired once per session (C/L, CHECK, UP, DOWN, ABN PROC dead after the first click); release them here, and read the three buttons the conversion named after BASE_NAME instead of SIMVAR (TOCONF, CLR_LH/CLR_RH, RCLLAST)
msfs_reason: fixes the X-Plane conversion's SASL bindings (aircraft/plugins/sasl/data/modules/main.lua) only ever sending the press half of ecam-cp.xml's LEFT_SINGLE_CODE/LEFT_LEAVE_CODE pair, plus three buttons the SASL conversion named after BASE_NAME instead of SIMVAR. MSFS's own model behaviours already send both halves and the correct SIMVAR names natively (this is a converter bug, not an FwsCore.ts bug), so FlyByWire's original ECP-acquisition code already works correctly in MSFS. Applying this patch would be redundant (harmless in practice, since the pulse nodes it feeds are edge-triggered) but serves no purpose there. Do not apply in MSFS.
